summary: Round 2, verifying c71e28b6 (atip.checkorder.17): the leading-option cases now answer USAGE --as (canon --as zzz nosuch, canon --as zzz, canon --as=zzz finding nosuch, --repo . --as zzz nosuch, --json --as zzz nosuch) and init --policy light --no-policy has expected [light, standard, strict] again. Not the whole of finding 1_1: canon finding --as zzz nosuch (the global --as written after a group word and before the unknown word) is still UNKNOWN_COMMAND, because leading_unknown_role only reads the tool-wide options written first on the line. It also reads std::env::args() instead of the args its caller passes, so parse() is no longer a function of its arguments (a unit test of parse with a vector cannot reach it). Finding 1_1 stays open for that shape; blast radius: a bad --as between group word and unknown command word only. L1.check-order passes on canon with a 1.2 claim (real checker, 1.2 fixture copy).
